title: Davapprove Kitsap approval dependency node register

nodes.title: Jurisdiction and tenure
nodes.trigger: Every parcel and off-site work area
nodes.evidence: Boundary, land tenure, road owner, utilities and responsible agencies confirmed
nodes.professional: Owner can research; written agency confirmation for ambiguity

nodes.title: Legal lot and property rights
nodes.trigger: Every new development; uncertain lot or access
nodes.evidence: Legal lot evidence; recorded access, utility, drainage rights
nodes.professional: Title review recommended; PLS/legal help as needed

nodes.title: Use and entitlement path
nodes.trigger: New use, added units, subdivision, variance or conditional use
nodes.evidence: Allowed-use determination or applicable entitlement; conditions
nodes.professional: Owner application possible; planner recommended for discretionary path

nodes.title: Common survey and base map
nodes.authority: Applicant; PLS where regulated surveying is needed
nodes.trigger: Boundary/topography uncertainty or survey requirement
nodes.evidence: Versioned boundaries, topography, easements, existing improvements
nodes.professional: PLS for regulated survey; not every application needs a new survey

nodes.title: Wetland / stream / habitat evidence
nodes.trigger: Potential critical areas or affected buffers, including off-site features
nodes.evidence: Delineation, rating, habitat assessment and review acceptance
nodes.professional: Qualified specialist when report required

nodes.title: Geotechnical / hydrogeological evidence
nodes.authority: Qualified geologist / geotechnical PE → local reviewers
nodes.trigger: Slope, soils, groundwater, foundation or drainage concern
nodes.evidence: Site-specific recommendations for foundation, discharge, grading
nodes.professional: Qualified licensed professional for required specialty report

nodes.title: Potable water adequacy
nodes.authority: Purveyor; KPHD; DOH / Ecology if applicable
nodes.trigger: Building needs water; changed demand or source
nodes.evidence: Availability / approved supply; physical and legal adequacy
nodes.professional: Owner can seek letter; specialist for source/system design

nodes.title: Wastewater branch determination
nodes.trigger: New/changed wastewater demand
nodes.evidence: Sewer required/available, existing OSS usable, or new OSS; regulator identified
nodes.professional: Owner inquiry; licensed designer for OSS design

nodes.title: Sewer service approval
nodes.trigger: Sewer branch selected or required
nodes.evidence: Capacity and connection approval; extension and easements where needed
nodes.professional: Civil design when utility requires it

nodes.title: Septic design / BSA approval
nodes.trigger: New OSS, added demand or redesign beyond clearance
nodes.evidence: Approved capacity and layout, primary + reserve area
nodes.professional: Licensed OSS designer or qualified PE

nodes.title: Existing septic building clearance
nodes.trigger: Existing system to support proposed project
nodes.evidence: System record, reserve, maintenance, plan and water compliance accepted
nodes.professional: Owner may apply; designer if capacity/layout change requires BSA

nodes.title: Coordinated site design
nodes.trigger: Every site; highest value on constrained parcels
nodes.evidence: One common revision fits house, septic, stormwater, access and buffers
nodes.blocks: Internal release to costly detailed design/submittal
nodes.professional: Recommended coordination gate, not a government permit

nodes.title: Civil drainage / grading design
nodes.trigger: Stormwater worksheet / site work triggers
nodes.evidence: Grading, runoff, infiltration/flow control, outfall and erosion plans
nodes.blocks: Applicable SDAP or building engineering review
nodes.professional: PE when code/manual/director requires; simpler route may not

nodes.title: Access and fire strategy
nodes.trigger: New/changed access, use, fire demand
nodes.evidence: Road geometry, turnarounds, access rights, fire flow or accepted alternative
nodes.professional: Civil/fire specialist as required; early review recommended

nodes.title: SEPA compliance
nodes.trigger: Nonexempt agency action; total proposal evaluated
nodes.evidence: Exemption basis or environmental review and determination
nodes.blocks: Nonexempt decisions and construction stormwater coverage
nodes.professional: Owner checklist possible; technical studies require their specialists

nodes.title: Local critical-area decision
nodes.trigger: Regulated critical-area development / buffer change
nodes.evidence: Compliance decision, mitigation or authorized exception
nodes.blocks: Affected local permit and regulated work
nodes.professional: Qualified reports; owner may submit application

nodes.title: Local shoreline decision
nodes.trigger: Development in shoreline jurisdiction
nodes.evidence: Compliance and exemption, SDP, CUP and/or variance as applicable
nodes.professional: Owner application possible; specialists for reports

nodes.title: Ecology shoreline decision
nodes.trigger: Shoreline CUP or variance
nodes.evidence: Ecology approval / conditions after local action
nodes.professional: No generic mandatory permit expediter

nodes.title: Shoreline legal release
nodes.trigger: Permit subject to statutory waiting / review period
nodes.evidence: Filing date + applicable waiting period and review disposition
nodes.professional: No required consultant; legal help if contested

nodes.title: Flood development review
nodes.trigger: Special flood hazard area development
nodes.evidence: Accepted elevations, no-rise / floodproofing / V-zone evidence as applicable
nodes.professional: Engineer/architect certifications where specified; survey as needed

nodes.title: Federal waters / permit applicability
nodes.trigger: Potential fill in WOTUS or work in navigable waters
nodes.evidence: Jurisdiction and general/individual permit route; PCN need
nodes.professional: Wetland/civil specialists recommended; Corps decides jurisdiction

nodes.title: Section 401 certification
nodes.trigger: Federal license/permit with potential discharge trigger
nodes.evidence: Certification, applicable general certification, or lawful waiver
nodes.professional: Technical evidence as project requires

nodes.title: ESA / EFH review
nodes.trigger: Federal action with species/habitat effects
nodes.evidence: Required effect determination, consultation and conditions
nodes.professional: Biologist generally needed for technical evaluation

nodes.title: Section 106 process
nodes.trigger: Federal undertaking with historic-property review
nodes.evidence: Area of potential effects, findings, consultation and resolution
nodes.professional: Qualified archaeologist if investigation required

nodes.title: Treaty-rights / tribal consultation
nodes.trigger: Project affects tribal rights/interests in federal review
nodes.evidence: Consultation record and resolved applicable constraints
nodes.professional: Agency-to-agency duty; consultant cannot substitute

nodes.title: Coastal consistency
nodes.trigger: Covered federal action affecting coastal resources
nodes.evidence: Applicable consistency concurrence / programmatic coverage
nodes.professional: Specialist support recommended

nodes.title: Corps authorization
nodes.trigger: Section 404 and/or Section 10 applies
nodes.evidence: Valid applicable authorization, conditions and approved footprint
nodes.professional: Applicant may apply; technical package often specialist-led

nodes.title: State-only wetland authorization
nodes.trigger: Wetland impact outside federal waters jurisdiction
nodes.evidence: State administrative order and mitigation
nodes.professional: Qualified wetland/civil support

nodes.title: Hydraulic Project Approval
nodes.trigger: Work uses/diverts/obstructs/changes flow or bed of state waters
nodes.evidence: HPA and conditions / work window, or documented nonapplicability
nodes.professional: Owner application possible; technical design when needed

nodes.title: Aquatic property authorization
nodes.trigger: Work on or over state-owned aquatic lands / other owned bedlands
nodes.evidence: Executed use authorization or property permission
nodes.professional: Owner application possible; early land-manager consult recommended

nodes.title: Archaeological alteration approval
nodes.authority: DAHP / applicable tribal or federal authority
nodes.trigger: Proposed alteration of protected archaeological site
nodes.evidence: Required permit and research/mitigation arrangements
nodes.blocks: Site alteration; discovery may stop affected work
nodes.professional: Professional archaeologist for required application/investigation

nodes.title: Construction stormwater coverage
nodes.trigger: Disturbance/discharge test including common plan and support areas
nodes.evidence: Permit coverage, SWPPP, required inspection/monitoring arrangements
nodes.professional: Permit-qualified erosion-control personnel where required

nodes.title: ROW / highway / road approach permit
nodes.authority: County PW, city or WSDOT as appropriate
nodes.trigger: Access connection or work in public ROW
nodes.evidence: Permit and conditions; preliminary highway letter may support local review
nodes.professional: Civil PE for engineered public improvements

nodes.title: Site development / clearing release
nodes.trigger: Grading/clearing/impervious and local triggers
nodes.evidence: SDAP or equivalent; preconstruction conditions satisfied
nodes.professional: PE per actual review tier

nodes.title: Building technical approval
nodes.authority: Local building + planning + engineering + fire reviewers
nodes.trigger: Building permit required
nodes.evidence: Plans, structural/energy compliance, relevant departmental approvals
nodes.professional: Owner prescriptive plans possible; required engineering separately

nodes.title: Building permit issued
nodes.trigger: All applicable issuance gates satisfied
nodes.evidence: Issued permit, approved revision, fees/conditions resolved
nodes.professional: No universal architect mandate

nodes.title: Septic installation permit
nodes.trigger: Construction of approved small OSS
nodes.evidence: Installation authorization after BSA and building milestone or waiver
nodes.professional: Certified installer; limited resident-owner installation route

nodes.title: Trade permits / utility energization
nodes.authority: Local trades; L&I or electrical AHJ; utilities
nodes.trigger: Electrical, plumbing, mechanical, fire-system and service work
nodes.evidence: Applicable permits, inspections and utility acceptance
nodes.professional: Owner electrical work possible within rules; hired contractor gets own permit

nodes.title: Inspections and certifications
nodes.authority: Permit agencies + design professionals / special inspectors
nodes.trigger: Construction milestones and permit conditions
nodes.evidence: Passed inspections, as-builts, testing and professional certifications
nodes.blocks: Concealment, next stage, occupancy or closeout
nodes.professional: Required special inspectors / certifying professionals

nodes.title: Occupancy authorization
nodes.authority: Local building authority with applicable agency releases
nodes.trigger: Occupied building or change of occupancy
nodes.evidence: Occupancy approval / CO; temporary CO only if expressly granted
nodes.professional: Owner coordinates releases

nodes.title: Long-term conditions and maintenance
nodes.trigger: Stormwater, septic, habitat mitigation or bonded work
nodes.evidence: Maintenance, monitoring, final stabilization and bond-release evidence
nodes.professional: Qualified service/monitoring providers when conditions require

nodes.title: Subdivision / final plat
nodes.trigger: New legal lots / plat alteration
nodes.evidence: Preliminary conditions; improvements/security; final approval and recording
nodes.blocks: Creation/use of new lots; downstream building route
nodes.professional: PLS for survey/plat; engineering as required

nodes.title: Forest conversion / tree clearing
nodes.authority: Local authority and DNR as applicable
nodes.trigger: Harvest, conversion, local tree controls or past forest activity
nodes.evidence: Correct clearing/conversion route; moratorium resolved if applicable
nodes.professional: Forester/arborist where required; land-use help recommended
